method: Full saved-corpus research decoding; no production codec execution, local tests, or native calls. The earlier static library inspection was removed.

fields.name: splitSequenceId
fields.meaning: One-based ordinal of this fragment in the ordered split of the source curve

fields.name: splitTotalNumber
fields.meaning: Number of fragments in that split of the source curve

evidence: Every one of the 84 split tags in the saved corpus satisfies 1 <= splitSequenceId <= splitTotalNumber
The corpus holds both non-final fragments such as (1,2) and final fragments such as (2,2) and (4,4)
domain.caveat: The field names and the producer invariant came from removed static evidence. The corpus is consistent with them, but they are not confirmed by a black-box experiment. A semantic reader can reject malformed pairs, but must not replace real split pairs with (1,1).

direction.evidence: The saved corpus holds the values 0, 1 and 4294967295. Treating 4294967295 as a wildcard came from removed static evidence and is not confirmed by a black-box experiment.
direction.restriction: Do not narrow the persisted direction callback to a Boolean

secondaryTag.meaning: Second identifier of the source sketch curve key; the role came from removed static evidence and is not confirmed by a black-box experiment
secondaryTag.limitation: This study does not establish nonzero secondary-ID allocation semantics. Retaining the existing zero-qualified profile is supported by this corpus.
